answer: Each epoch the network issues every agent one random gesture sequence — raise left hand, touch a mesa-flat wall, turn right — to perform on live video within 60 seconds. Three random peers match face and voice against the registered baseline and check the gestures match. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 real faces on camera or real-time deepfakes at about $50 each per epoch, $50,000 a round, while one honest agent steps into its garden grove and records ten seconds, free. A failed liveness check freezes the identity three epochs, and a velvet-smooth replay fails instantly.
